Drones hit Russian e-commerce giant Ozon's fulfillment hub in Adygeysk
Drone attack sparks fire at Ozon logistics centre in Russia’s Adygea
Ukraine drone strike sets fire to hub of e-retailer Ozon in southern Russia

stories.title: NASA X-59 Quiet Supersonic Aircraft Flies Six Times in One Week and Reaches Mach 1.53
stories.summary: NASA's X-59 quiet supersonic aircraft completed a record six flights in a single week, flying twice on Sept. 22 and twice each on Sept. 24 and 25. The run beat the aircraft's previous single-week record by two flights and brought its total to 38 test flights.

stories.title: France to Spend €63.4 Billion on Defense in 2027 as Euronaval Speech Highlights Naval Drones
stories.summary: French Armed Forces Minister Catherine Vautrin announced at the Euronaval trade show that the 2027 draft budget will increase defense spending to €63.4 billion, a €6.5 billion rise over 2026. The budget, submitted to the National Assembly and Senate in October, awaits a vote expected this month, with rejection resulting in a freeze rather than a cut.

also.title: Euronaval Opens with Paris Pushing Drones into the Fleet

stories.title: Tesla To Deploy Optimus Humanoid Robots To Plug In Driverless Cybercabs
stories.summary: Tesla Vice President of Vehicle Engineering Lars Moravy and Cybercab Program Lead Eric Earley revealed that the company intends to assign Optimus robots to Supercharger hubs to physically plug in autonomous Cybercabs. This robotic solution serves as a transitional bridge while Tesla deploys long-term high-power wireless resonance charging infrastructure.

stories.title: Russian builder tests unmanned cargo boat for Ob and Irtysh River supply runs
stories.summary: Russia's Pskov Boat Shipyard tested an unmanned cargo boat on Lake Pskov, with a representative of the Russian Maritime Register of Shipping attending as an expert observer. The vessel, which has a maximum cargo capacity of 1,500 kg, will soon begin delivering construction materials, food, and fuel to remote settlements on the Irtysh and Ob Rivers with no people aboard.

stories.title: Tesla crash LA — Autonomous Vehicle Hits Fire Hydrant in South El Monte
stories.summary: A Tesla operating in autonomous mode struck a fire hydrant at the intersection of Santa Anita Avenue and Central Avenue in South El Monte around 4:17 AM on the 3rd, leaving two occupants uninjured. San Gabriel Valley Water Company crews cut off the water supply after firefighters struggled to stop the flow, while authorities restricted access to the area during cleanup.

stories.title: Tesla misled South Korean customers about automated-driving tech, consumer group alleges
stories.summary: A consumer group alleges Tesla misled South Korean customers by selling Full Self-Driving (FSD) software for 9.043 million won ($6,726) to vehicles that cannot legally use it. The software is compatible with only about 20% of Tesla cars registered in the country, mainly US-made models.

stories.title: Europe Plans Naval Drone Attacks on Russian Tankers
stories.summary: European countries plan naval drone attacks on Russia's shadow fleet in the Baltic and North seas, with operations overseen by Stephen Bryan. German firm Stark Defence began mass production of Vanta 24 unmanned vessels, which cost roughly 1,000 times less than a traditional frigate and can carry payloads up to 50 tonnes.

stories.title: Boston Dynamics unveils second-generation Stretch logistics robot with improved durability
stories.summary: Boston Dynamics unveiled the second-generation Stretch logistics robot on Tuesday, reducing internal wiring by 81 percent and upgrading joints to improve durability based on 100,000 hours of operational data. The company plans to expand supply to DHL and other global logistics firms, with DHL having signed a memorandum of understanding to introduce more than 1,000 additional units.

also.title: Boston Dynamics cuts Stretch robot cabling by 81%, speeds up repairs in Gen 2 upgrade

stories.title: Bulgaria Joins NATO Drone Defense Project After Drones Sink Two Ships
stories.summary: Bulgaria signed on October 30 to join NATO’s Air Defence Capabilities Against Lower-Level Air Threats High Visibility Project, a multinational program for buying and developing defenses against drones and cruise missiles that fly low. Defense Minister Dimitar Stoyanov signed the accession note, and the National Assembly still has to ratify it.

stories.title: China's EHang establishes regional hub in Thailand to support eVTOL ecosystem development
stories.summary: EHang announced the establishment of an overseas regional hub in Thailand to support international electric vertical take-off and landing (“eVTOL”) aircraft deployment, regional resource coordination and project implementation across Southeast Asia and other emerging markets. In the near term, EHang plans to deploy an initial fleet of 25 units of EH216-S pilotless passenger-carrying eVTOL aircraft in Thailand.

stories.title: Humanoid Robots in Warehouses vs AMRs: Which Automation Makes Sense in 2026?
stories.summary: GXO and Agility Robotics announced a commercial Robots-as-a-Service agreement in June 2024 to deploy Digit in warehouse operations. The robot handles repetitive material-moving tasks, including transferring totes to conveyors, while working alongside existing automation such as autonomous mobile robots.

stories.title: Wildwood Crest Police Use Drone to Find Missing Dog [VIDEO]
stories.summary: The Wildwood Crest Police Department used its Drone Unit to locate a missing dog in the dunes near Sunrise Park on Monday. Officers detected a heat signature using the unmanned aircraft system's thermal imaging capabilities after the dog ran off while being walked on a leash.

stories.title: Californians revolt against police drones after rapid adoption across state
stories.summary: California police departments are expanding drone programs to conduct everyday patrols and active investigations, a shift that has triggered public backlash and legal challenges. The San Francisco Police Department recently sought approval for broader drone use, while Sonoma County settled a lawsuit by the ACLU of Northern California after investigators found hundreds of warrantless searches.

stories.title: Kodiak AI Delivers Western Star 49X Trucks to Atlas Energy Solutions, Beginning Next Autonomous Chapter in the Permian Basin
stories.summary: Kodiak AI delivered the first two Western Star 49X trucks equipped with the Kodiak Driver to Atlas Energy Solutions in September. These are the first of 65 trucks to fulfill Atlas’s initial order of 100 Kodiak-equipped driverless trucks, with Kodiak on track to complete that order in the first half of 2027.

stories.title: Beta Technologies (BETA) Q3 2026 Earnings Call: Record Revenue, Guidance Raised
stories.summary: Beta Technologies reported record Q3 2026 revenue of $17.7 million and raised full-year guidance to $52 million–$57 million. The company received FAA market survey authorization for the ALIA A250 and completed a 34-nautical-mile vertical-to-vertical flight.

stories.title: Modular Gun Systems Might Make Drone Strikes Optional
stories.summary: BAE Systems and Aselsan are marketing modular deck gun systems for merchant ships at the Euronaval show, offering alternatives to accepting drone and missile strikes. Aselsan's Gokdeniz system features a twin 35mm turret firing up to 1,100 rounds per minute, while BAE Systems proposes a 40mm Bofors gun with programmable ammunition and optional integrated fire control radar.

stories.title: The United States is testing anti-drone systems at its Naval Base in Guantanamo
stories.summary: The U.S. military conducted drone defense exercises at Guantanamo Naval Base to test capabilities against small unmanned aerial systems. The training involved Joint Interagency Task Force 401, Southern Command, and the Fourth Fleet, utilizing simulated enemy forces to verify operational readiness.

stories.title: KNAPP Establishes Robotics and AI Innovation Hub in Boston, Plans 35 Jobs
stories.summary: KNAPP established KNAPPRobotics.ai Inc. in Somerville, Massachusetts, to create a U.S. robotics and artificial intelligence development hub. The facility is expected to employ 30 to 35 people by early 2027, focusing on software development, AI, and computer vision to accelerate commercialization of warehouse automation technologies.

stories.title: Ben Waters on the latest wireless charging strategies
stories.summary: Ben Waters, CEO of WiBotic, discussed wireless charging strategies for mobile robot fleets on The Robot Report Podcast. He explained how opportunity charging reduces downtime for fleets of 20 to 40 robots and advised companies to plan power infrastructure, battery size, and maintenance during system design.

stories.title: Pentagon is beginning to follow Ukraine into wider use of ground robots
EU and Bpifrance Target 30 French-Ukrainian Drone and Defense Deals
stories.summary: The European Commission and Bpifrance launched a €150 million guarantee programme on November 3 to facilitate 30 French-Ukrainian defense partnerships over three years. The initiative targets sectors including drones and communications, with Ukrainian companies able to borrow up to 85% of commercial contract values.

stories.title: Ukraine Will Fund Drone-Fired Air-to-Air Missiles to Catch Jet Shaheds
stories.summary: Ukraine's Brave1 cluster opened grant competition No. 11 on October 29, offering up to four grants of as much as ₴75 million each to build drone-launched air-to-air missiles. The Ministry of Defence aims to cut the cost of intercepting jet-powered drones like the Geran-4, with winners required to reach the required readiness level within 16 months.

stories.title: Houston Weighs Counter-Drone Bid as Texas Pot Shrinks to $10.5M
stories.summary: Houston City Council votes Wednesday on whether the Mayor’s Office of Public Safety and Homeland Security can apply for FEMA’s Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems Grant Program. Texas will receive $10,508,140 for the whole state in this round, and FEMA expects to pick projects on December 2 and issue awards on December 10.

stories.title: Waymo's Next Driverless Taxi Is A Factory-Built Toyota bZ
stories.summary: Toyota will assemble a modified bZ robotaxi with Waymo's Level 4 autonomous hardware in its Takaoka plant in Japan, with fleet operations starting in 2027. The companies are also researching ways to incorporate Waymo's self-driving tech into personally owned Toyota vehicles.

also.title: Waymo’s next robotaxi is a purpose-built Toyota bZ4X
Toyota and Waymo target 2027 start for autonomous bZ4X fleet
Toyota to Start Building Self-Driving Cars in 2027 Through Waymo Partnership
Waymo Toyota: 1 Bold Robotaxi Deal With a Winning Partner

stories.title: A French Sovereign Drone, Ordered From a Chinese Catalogue
stories.summary: Airbus displayed the U050 Capa-X at Euronaval in Paris, claiming it is a sovereign design for the French Navy and Army. The article alleges the airframe matches the Mugin UAV GV500 and GV600 platforms, contradicting Airbus's claims of uncompromising airworthiness and national sovereignty.

stories.title: Safran and UVAD Technologies join forces to power Falcon supersonic UAV
stories.summary: Safran Power Units and UVAD Technologies Inc. announced a partnership to power the Falcon Supersonic UAV with two turbojet engines. The system enables supersonic speeds at low and medium altitudes for missile defense training, with ground testing scheduled for 2026 and flight tests in 2027.

stories.title: XTEND AI Robotics (XTND) Stock: Expands Defense Footprint With 88 Drone Deliveries
stories.summary: XTEND AI Robotics completed a $2.8 million defense contract in Asia-Pacific, delivering 88 unmanned aerial systems and 84 ground control stations through its subsidiary Performance Rotors Pte Ltd in September 2026. The company reported that the transaction contributes to its previously disclosed unaudited revenue range of approximately $24.5 million to $26.5 million through September 30, 2026.

stories.title: Driverless Tesla Robotaxis are now cruising in Fort Worth
stories.summary: Tesla launched driverless Robotaxi service in Fort Worth on Monday, November 2, covering a roughly 145-square-mile area that includes Benbrook, Forest Hill, Haltom City, River Oaks, Saginaw, and White Settlement. The service uses modified Model Y electric vehicles seating up to four passengers, making Fort Worth the seventh U.S. market in the network.

stories.title: TAA Compliance Shapes Battery Strategy in America’s Drone Market
stories.summary: Enovix and Rincell are positioning their battery products for U.S. federal drone procurement by meeting Trade Agreements Act compliance requirements. Enovix manufactures TAA-compliant batteries in South Korea, while Rincell plans to launch fully domestic cell production in Fremont, California, in late 2027.

stories.title: Beta boss Clark believes A250 will beat eVTOL rivals to certification
stories.summary: Lufthansa Group carrier is the first European operator to sign an agreement with the US-based eVTOL developer. Operator highlights importance of real-world trials ahead of first electric aircraft deployment from 2028.

stories.title: Good Work Pays Off on the Red River Valley & Western Railroad
stories.summary: The Federal Railroad Administration selected the Red River Valley & Western Railroad for a CRISI grant of up to $23,646,750 to replace approximately 26.4 miles of rail and 19,200 ties between Gwinner and Wyndmere, ND. The project will also extend the existing 1,800-foot siding at Wahpeton Junction to approximately 10,000 feet.

stories.title: KUKA to Feature Advanced Industrial Robot and Mobile Automation at the Smart Technology Expo 2026
stories.summary: KUKA Robotics will exhibit a KR AGILUS industrial robot, an LBR iisy collaborative robot, and a KMP 250P autonomous mobile robot at Smart Technology Expo 2026 in Guadalajara, Mexico, from November 18-20. The company will demonstrate pick-and-place applications and 3D vision-guided picking in booth C20, while Christopher Hernández participates in a panel discussion on November 18.

stories.title: Ethiopian Rebels Deploy Drones
stories.summary: A series of explosions at Ethiopia’s defense headquarters and military bases in late September raise concerns that northern rebels might be using drones to extend their fight to other parts of the country. Witnesses told the Ethiopian Observer that a small, short-range drone exploded inside the Ethiopian Air Force base at Bishoftu, about 40 kilometers southeast of the capital, Addis Ababa.

stories.title: UCLA stockpiles huge arsenal of drones, ammo for emergencies
stories.summary: The UCLA Police Department spent more than $220,000 on drones and less-than-lethal munitions in 2025 and is seeking approval to purchase more. The department bought three Skydio X10s and 120 40 mm munitions, and it is requesting 1,950 additional PepperBall rounds and 50 more 40 mm projectiles to support campus expansion and the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

stories.title: AIRO Group offers upside as military drone demand accelerates: Roth Capital
stories.summary: Roth Capital Partners initiated coverage of AIRO Group Holdings with a Buy rating and $16 price target, citing growing demand for military drones and a potential revenue surge in 2027. The firm projects AIRO's revenue to increase from approximately $134 million in 2026 to $207 million in 2027, driven by drone deliveries and expansion into autonomous aircraft.

stories.title: Video: A fire has been burning for a second day at the "Samara" gas station in Russia following a drone attack
stories.summary: A drone strike on November 2, 2026, ignited a fire at the “Samara” Linear Production and Dispatch Station in the Samara Region, which has burned for a second day despite local authorities claiming the attack was repelled. The Kazakh Ministry of Energy temporarily suspended crude oil transit to Russia via the Atyrau-Samara pipeline due to infrastructure damage at the facility, which stores over 1.6 million cubic meters of crude oil.

stories.title: Humanoid Robot Makers Track Output but Not Payback
stories.summary: AGIBOT introduced Worken on Oct. 29 as a metric for “effective intelligent work hours,” calculated by multiplying active robots, autonomous working hours, and an output efficiency ratio. The company stated the measure aims to compare productivity across industrial handling, logistics, inspection, and commercial services, potentially shifting robot pricing from equipment purchases to productivity packages.

stories.title: Airbus ends Wingman drone to meet Germany’s accelerated operations timeline
stories.summary: Airbus ended development of its Wingman drone to meet Germany's accelerated timeline, shifting focus to the U760 Ravenstorm Collaborative Combat Aircraft. The U760 targets a 2032 service entry, while the U740 Valkyrie aims for a 2029 requirement.

stories.title: Waymo Pushes Into LA’s South Bay as Robotaxi Map Widens Across 15 US Cities
stories.summary: Waymo extended its Los Angeles robotaxi service to Torrance, El Segundo, and Manhattan Beach on Tuesday, expanding the service area to 210 square miles. The Alphabet unit is scaling operations in five cities, adding nearly 250 square miles of territory across Los Angeles, Nashville, Orlando, San Diego, and the San Francisco Bay Area.

stories.title: Mountain rescuers turn to automated DJI drones to save time
stories.summary: Poland's TOPR is piloting DJI Dock 4 technology to launch Matrice 5TD drones from automated rooftop docks, reducing the up to two hours it currently takes to reach remote Tatra Mountain accident sites. The system uses DJI O4 ground stations to extend coverage and swaps batteries in 25 seconds to maintain continuous aerial search operations.

also.title: DJI Dock 4 Lands in Tatra Mountains: Autonomous Rescue, No Handler Required

stories.title: Prototype X-BAT VTOL ‘Fighter’ Drone Unveiled
stories.summary: Shield AI shared the first look at a full-scale prototype of its X-BAT jet-powered stealth ‘fighter’ drone, which is designed to both take off and land vertically from a tail-sitting position. The drone is in the process of being moved from the company’s main hub in Frisco, Texas, to its flight test facility in Newton, Kansas.

also.title: First look: Shield AI rolls out X-BAT 001 as autonomous fighter approaches flight testing
First full-scale X-BAT combat drone prototype packs 2,000-mile range, vertical flight
Shield AI Reveals X-BAT 001 Autonomous Fighter with Redesigned Air Intake and Installed Engine Ahead of Flight Tests

stories.title: Drones built to look like birds evaded detection at Air Force tech exercise
stories.summary: Ornadyne’s O1 ornithopter drone evaded sensor detection at the Air Force’s September “Game of Drones” exercise at Edwards Air Force Base. The 1-pound drone, which flaps wings instead of using propellers, registered as a bird to counter-UAS systems deployed by other private companies.

stories.title: USDOT deploys $1.24B for rail work via IIJA funds
OpenRoboto and Vulcan Shield Hungary Launch Commercial Robotics Data Pilot
stories.summary: OpenRoboto launched its first commercial robotics data pilot with Vulcan Shield Hungary at a production workstation in Békéscsaba to capture human operating expertise for task-specific robot capabilities. The three-stage collaboration begins with simulation and data capture using OR-S1 egocentric headsets, with model training and on-site robotic testing planned for subsequent stages.

stories.title: Westborough braces for round-2 on Amazon drone delivery
stories.summary: Amazon withdrew its drone proposal in Westborough, leaving the Zoning Board of Appeals with nothing to rule on as the board keeps the appeal open to revisit in early December. Company spokesperson Lindsay Hamilton said Amazon will resubmit a “revised project soon, after further discussions with local stakeholders.”

also.title: Amazon's Next Westborough Drone Plan Needs a New Zoning Ruling

stories.title: Securing autonomous fleet communications at scale with mTLS over QUIC using Network Load Balancer passthrough
stories.summary: AWS published a technical guide demonstrating how to secure autonomous fleet communications using mutual TLS over QUIC with Network Load Balancer passthrough. The article details a reference implementation for Zipline, which operates drone fleets, showing how to configure Amazon EKS and the AWS Load Balancer Controller to maintain connection stability during cellular handoffs.

stories.title: Defense contractors to demo cargo drones for US Marine Corps
BAE Systems launches new Sea Tridon naval gun series
stories.summary: BAE Systems debuted the Sea Tridon naval gun series at the Euronaval defense show in Paris, offering three variants derived from the Bofors 40 Mk4. The company is discussing integration of the guns on unmanned systems with several navies, though it has not yet secured a launch customer.

stories.title: Norway strengthens border surveillance system to detect drones near Russia
stories.summary: The Norwegian Armed Forces are deploying NASAMS sensors in Kirkenes to detect drones near the Russian border. The unit, comprising more than 30 military personnel, will be stationed within the Ranger Battalion GSV in Sør-Varanger by the end of the year.

also.title: Norway deploys NASAMS to Russian border to spot stray drones

stories.title: MTDG Launches Industrywide Survey to Shape a Trusted Drone Component Marketplace
FMD debuts AutoHook at Euronaval 2026 for autonomous USV recovery
stories.summary: Fairbanks Morse Defense debuted AutoHook, a fully autonomous vessel recovery interface developed by Vestdavit, at Euronaval 2026 in Paris. The system enables launch and recovery of uncrewed surface vessels without human intervention and achieved operational acceptance at Sea State 4, surpassing standard solutions restricted to Sea State 2.

stories.title: Tesla forced to rename 'misleading' Full Self-Driving technology in the UK and Europe — as BMW readies its own automated driving rival for 2027
stories.summary: Following intervention from Germany’s transport ministry, Tesla agreed to rename its Full Self-Driving technology to “Tesla Assisted Driving” in Europe and the UK. The change addresses concerns that the previous name was misleading, as the system requires drivers to remain attentive at all times.

also.title: Tesla renames Full Self-Driving as Tesla Assisted Driving in Europe and the UK
Tesla owners can earn up to 12 months of free Full Self-Driving (FSD) via the Referral Program
80 Tesla Owners Arrested For Allegedly 'Jailbreaking' Full Self-Driving Mode

stories.title: Agility Robotics clears shareholder vote, expected to go public this week
stories.summary: Agility Robotics raised $465 million to resolve debts ahead of its $2.5 billion merger with Churchill Capital Corp XI, with common stock scheduled to begin trading Thursday. The company aims to reach 100 customers and 25 facility deployments by the end of 2027, while expanding partnerships with GXO Logistics, Agco, Toyota, and Schaeffler.

also.title: Agility Robotics Begins Trading On Nasdaq As AGLT After SPAC Vote

stories.title: Schneider shifts eastern intermodal freight to Norfolk Southern
stories.summary: Schneider named Norfolk Southern its primary eastern rail provider Oct. 29, with the agreement taking effect Jan. 1. The company said the deal expands its reach, supports new freight, and enables potential transcontinental service with Union Pacific.

stories.title: Russia gives its drones bigger antennas to beat Ukraine's jamming
stories.summary: Russia is upgrading its attack drones with larger anti-jamming antennas to counter Ukraine's electronic warfare systems. The upgrades use Kometa satellite-navigation modules with 16-element antenna arrays, with 20-element versions prepared for serial production.

stories.title: Numo Robotics Unveiled the Loko ROV for Cargo Transport and Equipment Recovery
stories.summary: Numo Robotics developed Loko, a wheeled ground robot designed for logistics and the evacuation of damaged military equipment. The system can carry loads weighing up to 500 kg and can also help retrieve other ground drones from the battlefield.

stories.title: A Renaissance Of U.S.-Based Drone Battery Production
stories.summary: Global Ordnance plans to deliver 10,000 batteries in 2027, scaling to 150,000 by 2029, while Amprius received a grant worth up to $75 million to add 12 million silicon anode cells annually by early 2028.

stories.title: Cheyenne Finance Committee to talk Reed Avenue Rail Corridor project expansion
stories.summary: The Cheyenne Finance Committee is set to discuss a plan to increase the Reed Avenue Rail Corridor Design Project contract by $1,166,647, bringing the total cost to $2,487,566. If approved, the expansion would add street improvements to Snyder and Bent Avenues, a parking lot, and pedestrian connectivity, extending the completion date to April 30, 2028.

stories.title: Nuro Trains Police as Uber, Lucid Gravity Robotaxi Nears Launch
stories.summary: Nuro met with police departments in Mountain View, Palo Alto, and Los Altos to prepare for its robotaxi launch with Uber and Lucid, the company said on Tuesday. The partners are targeting a San Francisco Bay Area launch this year, though the program still lacks the state permits needed for driverless or paid rides.

stories.title: German company “Stark” is developing an unmanned ship that will track Russian shadow fleet vessels
stories.summary: German defense startup Stark Defence plans to launch the 24-meter-long unmanned vessel Vanta 24 next year to protect undersea cables and monitor Russia’s shadow fleet. The ship will carry up to 50 tons of cargo, including missiles and cannons, and reach speeds over 64 kmph.

also.title: German startup develops unmanned vessel to monitor Russia's shadow fleet and protect undersea cables

stories.title: Can Commercial Drones Survive Electronic Warfare? U.S. Army Expands Testing Opportunities
Lockheed Martin to build five Vectis combat drones with flight demonstrations due in 2027
stories.summary: Lockheed Martin will use its own funds to build five Vectis autonomous combat aircraft, with flight demonstrations scheduled for 2027, Chief Executive Jim Taiclet said. The company anticipates an opportunity under the U.S. Air Force’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft Increment 2 program and is designing the aircraft for air-to-air combat and strike missions.

stories.title: US Navy Procures Autonomous Minesweepers Under $53.9 Million Deal
stories.summary: The US Navy signed a $53.9 million contract with Thales subsidiary Advanced Acoustic Concepts to acquire two unmanned minesweepers for the Strait of Hormuz. The vessels use towed sonar and Automatic Target Recognition software to detect and classify underwater mines, with neutralization capabilities planned for a later phase.

stories.title: Satellite Connectivity for Drones Moves Closer to Commercial Scale
stories.summary: Galaxy 1 Communications and Viasat announced an agreement on November 2, 2026, to move their jointly developed Velaris satellite communications platform into commercial production. The partnership provides systems for customer onboarding, billing, and network management to support autonomous aircraft and advanced air mobility operations.

also.title: Galaxy 1 and Viasat Expand Velaris Satellite Communications for Commercial UAV Operations
Galaxy 1 and Viasat “validate Velaris satcom services for eVTOLs and autonomous delivery aircraft”
Galaxy 1 and Viasat Move UAV Connectivity Platform into Commercial Production

stories.title: ETH Zurich Develops Flexible Drone That Can Survive Collisions
stories.summary: Researchers at ETH Zurich developed FlexiQuad, a flexible drone that withstands collisions at speeds of approximately 25 kilometers per hour while reaching 80 kilometers per hour during normal flight. The design uses a ring-shaped frame that bends sideways to absorb impact, allowing the drone to remain airborne and continue missions in tight spaces.

stories.title: Elbit Systems Expands Integrated Naval Protection Suite To Counter Unmanned And Underwater Threats
stories.summary: Elbit Systems is participating in Euronaval 2026 in Paris, France, where it is showcasing maritime defense solutions. The company offers an integrated naval protection suite combining electronic warfare, Counter-UxS technologies, kinetic defense, and underwater sensing capabilities.

also.title: Elbit Systems expands naval counter-UAS suite with radar, electronic warfare and 30mm ammunition

stories.title: Tesla Cybercab Test Fleet Expands to Detroit
stories.summary: Tesla expanded its Cybercab testing to Metro Detroit, deploying approximately two dozen autonomous vehicles from a Southfield, Michigan facility. The test cars, equipped with temporary steering wheels and human drivers, operate on roads including Interstate 696 and M-10, while Tesla has not provided a timeline for public operations.

also.title: Tesla Tests About Two Dozen Cybercabs on Detroit Roads

stories.title: Latvia believes one of two drones that violated its airspace was Russian, the other Ukrainian
stories.summary: Latvia’s military said on Tuesday it believed one of two drones that violated the country’s airspace in recent days was of Russian origin, while the other was of Ukrainian origin. The armed forces warned on Sunday and again on Monday of threats in Latvia’s airspace near the borders of Belarus and Russia, asking people in the area to seek shelter, and in the latter case said NATO had activated air policing fighter jets.

stories.title: UK Deploys Protector Drone to Track Russian Frigate in English Channel
stories.summary: The Royal Air Force Protector RG1 conducted its first operational sorties in UK airspace, providing over 10 hours of surveillance as HMS Dauntless and HMS Tyne shadowed the Russian frigate Neustrashimy in the English Channel between October 1 and October 14.

stories.title: As drones multiply, the battle to control low-altitude airspace intensifies
stories.summary: Airwayz integrated its OVERWATCH command-and-control platform with more than 45 sensors, effectors, and command-and-control systems during a recent NATO exercise. The platform achieved SAPIENT compliance, an interoperability standard designed to facilitate communication between different sensors and systems.

stories.title: Washington blocked Polestar. So why are Chinese-built robotaxis on American streets?
LLANGENNECH: Train firm blames a signaller for the diesel fire and wants £30m from Network Rail
stories.summary: DB Cargo UK is suing Network Rail for more than £30m, arguing a signaller failed to stop the 2020 Llangennech fuel train derailment. Network Rail counters with a claim for over £5m against DB Cargo and wagon owner Touax Rail, who denies liability. No hearing date has been set.

stories.title: MassDOT breaks ground on rail improvements to support permanent Berkshire Flyer service
stories.summary: MassDOT broke ground on rail infrastructure improvements in Pittsfield, Mass., to support permanent seasonal Berkshire Flyer service. The project includes a passing track in Richmond and upgrades at CSX's Pittsfield Yard, with $31 million allocated in the fiscal year 2027–2031 Capital Investment Plan.

stories.title: CTDOT starts construction on new train station in Enfield
stories.summary: The Connecticut Department of Transportation (CTDOT) has started construction on a new train station in Enfield, Conn., and restore passenger rail service to the town for the first time since 1986. The $125.3 million project is anticipated to be completed in fall 2030 and will fill an approximately 15-mile gap between Springfield Union Station and Windsor Locks.

stories.title: US Army flies first 3D-printed heavy-fuel engine to extend tactical drone range
stories.summary: The US Army successfully flight-tested its first 3D-printed heavy-fuel hybrid engine installed in the VICTOR unmanned aircraft. The air-cooled design eliminates liquid coolant, extending mid-sized tactical drone reach to support future autonomous swarm missions under the PULSAR initiative.

stories.title: Russia Threatened Terra Drone. Its CEO's Biggest Worry Is Taiwan
stories.summary: Terra Drone president Toru Tokushige warned that a Taiwan crisis would halt drone production because the company relies on foreign suppliers for most components. He stated that rebuilding those parts domestically would take six months to a year, leaving Japan vulnerable to attack during that window.

stories.title: Specialist drone-detection equipment brought to Jersey as investigation continues
stories.summary: The government confirmed that specialist drone-detection equipment is now in Jersey to help agencies detect and respond to further drone activity at the Airport. Police are continuing to pursue all credible lines of enquiry into suspected drone sightings on Friday and Saturday evenings that caused significant disruption, including three inbound aircraft diversions and nine cancelled clinical procedures.

also.title: Jersey Strengthens Drone Detection Measures Following Airport Disruption

stories.title: U.S. deploys missile and anti-drone laser systems near Trump’s Mar-a-Lago residence amid tensions with Iran
stories.summary: U.S. air defense systems, including AN/TWQ-1 Avengers and a Locust anti-drone laser, were deployed near Mar-a-Lago in Palm Beach, Florida, about two weeks ago. The measures follow heightened tensions with Iran and a security incident at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner in April 2026.

also.title: A LOCUST laser drone defense system has been deployed near Trump's estate in Florida
Anti-drone laser spotted near Trump's Mar-a-Lago estate, media report

stories.title: French defense minister kicks off ‘pact’ with industry in rush to field naval drones
stories.summary: French Minister of the Armed Forces Catherine Vautrin announced a new government-industry “pact” on Nov. 3 to accelerate the development of naval drones. The initiative includes purchasing a second ROV Deep Sea drone from LD Travocean and eight A18 countermine robots from Exail.

also.title: France launches industry pact to develop naval drones — Defense News

stories.title: US Army advances first vehicle-mounted laser weapon production to destroy enemy drones
stories.summary: Leonardo DRS will supply power management, thermal control, and integration expertise for AeroVironment's LOCUST X3 laser weapon production under the Army's E-HEL program. The 30-kilowatt LOCUST X3 is designed to counter Group 1–3 drones and integrate with platforms such as the Joint Light Tactical Vehicle.

stories.title: Russia’s “Terminator” Tank Support Vehicle Spotted With Basic Anti-Drone Nets Instead of Armor
stories.summary: Russian forces deployed BMPT tank support vehicles fitted with flexible mesh barriers at the front and rear during spring 2026 exercises. The makeshift protection leaves upper surfaces exposed to aerial attacks, and the rear-mounted mesh visibly swings as the vehicle moves.

stories.title: Baidu launches AI system to train robotaxis for global expansion
stories.summary: Baidu launched Apollo World, an artificial intelligence system that generates up to 100,000 kilometres of simulated driving daily to train its Apollo Go robotaxi fleet for international operations. The technology aims to reduce development costs by simulating road conditions and predicting environmental changes over time.

Baidu launches Apollo World to train robotaxis in simulation

stories.title: Why Is the Pentagon Lending $450 Million to a Drone Developer?
stories.summary: The Department of Defense’s Office of Strategic Capital announced a conditional loan commitment of up to $450 million to Neros to expand domestic production of small unmanned aircraft systems and components in Torrance, California. The financing supports vertical integration to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers and meet growing military demand for inexpensive drones.

stories.title: HII and Thales Demonstrate Expeditionary PathMaster’s Ability to Deliver an End-to-End Autonomous MCM
stories.summary: HII and Thales demonstrated an end-to-end autonomous mine countermeasure capability using Thales’ Expeditionary PathMaster architecture. The system integrated HII’s REMUS 620 unmanned underwater vehicle, Thales’ SAMDIS 600 sonar, and ANGLER neutralization capabilities into a unified workflow for mine detection, classification, and neutralization.

stories.title: 36Kr Exclusive: Shanghai Jiao Tong University PhD Graduate Integrates World Models with Six-Arm Robots, Secures Hundreds of Millions Yuan New Financing and Partners with Multiple Fortune 500 Clients
stories.summary: Shanghai SAZHI Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. completed a Pre-Series B financing of hundreds of millions of yuan from China Construction Investment Co., Ltd., Nantong Investment Management, and Yunqi Partners. The company will use the funds for large model R&D, multi-arm robot prototype iteration, production line expansion, and global market development.

stories.title: Alpha Unmanned Systems Closes €4 Million Financing Round
stories.summary: Alpha Unmanned Systems closed a €4 million financing round on November 3, 2026, backed by Cesce, Banco Santander, Bankinter, and BBVA. The Madrid-based company will use the funds to build a new production plant, hire staff, and accelerate expansion into Europe, the United States, Latin America, and Asia.

stories.title: Fast autonomous combat boat packs missile-firing power at speeds over 45 mph
stories.summary: Swedish defense company Saab unveiled the 18-meter CB90 Capability X, an optionally crewed combat boat that can operate autonomously and reach speeds exceeding 40 knots. The vessel offers more than 50 percent greater payload capacity than the CB90 Next Generation and features three configurations for reconnaissance, anti-ship missile, and short-range air defense missions. Sweden is the launch customer, with the new boats expected to complement the Swedish Navy’s existing CB90 fleet.

also.title: Saab unveils combat boat with autocannon-based counter-drone capability
Saab Develops New Fully Autonomous CB 90 USV for the Swedish Navy

stories.title: Russia Imposes Over 3,500 Airport Flight Restrictions in 2026 Amid Ukrainian Drone Attacks
stories.summary: Russian airports imposed about 3,594 flight restrictions between January and October 2026 amid Ukrainian drone attacks, affecting Moscow hubs and border facilities. In October, more than 51,900 flights were delayed by at least 15 minutes and over 7,000 were canceled across 118 airports nationwide.

stories.title: New ISO interoperability standard covers collaboration among mobile robots from multiple vendors
stories.summary: The Association for Advancing Automation published ISO 21423:2026, an international standard for communications among industrial mobile robots from different vendors. The standard specifies how robots, fleet managers, and other equipment exchange information to improve system efficiency and reduce path interference.

stories.title: Purdue’s Windracers ULTRA First Flyer in Indiana Drone Corridor
stories.summary: Purdue University's Windracers ULTRA completed the first beyond visual line of sight flight in the new Indiana Drone Corridor, covering more than 50 miles during an opening event at Terre Haute Regional Airport. The university will use the aircraft to test emergency supply drops for flood-affected communities.

also.title: Windracers ULTRA flies BVLOS in Indiana’s new drone corridor
Purdue-Owned Windracers ULTRA Is First Autonomous Aircraft to Fly BVLOS in Indiana Drone Corridor

stories.title: Autonomous Freight Rail Pilot to Begin in 2027
stories.summary: Intramotev plans to deploy two battery-electric TugVolt railcars on the 21-mile Columbia Terminal Railroad in early to mid-2027, following a $16.2 million Federal Railroad Administration award. The three-year demonstration will progress through milestone-gated stages toward autonomous mainline operations, beginning with local service to seven customers in the Columbia area.

stories.title: Spanish Army's Own Experts Say Red Tape Is Slowing Its FPV Drone Shift
stories.summary: Ten Spanish Army specialists told a University of Granada researcher that legal and bureaucratic procedures are slowing the military's adoption of FPV drones. The Spanish Army established its FPV flight school, the Escuela Práctica de Vuelo, in October 2025, but rules allowing the Army to certify pilots flying drones under 25 kg (55 pounds) were still being developed.
